CustomField.description: Resilient retrieval fires the distillation second pass only when the first pass topScore is BELOW this value. Default 0.45 = the draft floor, so we distil exactly the cases that would otherwise not draft and never pay a call on a case that already has a strong match. Only used when Retrieval_Query_Distill_Enabled__c is true.
CustomField.label: Retrieval Distill Trigger Score
